Diwali is here, and what's a celebration without some delicious mithai? This time, I'm giving our favourite festive sweets a healthier twist with these absolutely delicious Chocolate Walnut Fudge Mithais!
I'm making 3 different variations, Chocolate Walnut Fudge Katli, Barfi and Laddoos. The best part? All three are made with zero added sugar, come together really quickly and taste incredible! They're rich, chocolatey, nutty and have that perfect melt-in-your-mouth texture.
